description: Source code for the FilterWrapper component in Android's media codec framework, implementing filtering and component wrapping logic for codec components.

classes.name: WrappedDecoderInterface
classes.description: A wrapper around C2ComponentInterface that manages a chain of filter components, handling parameter transfer and query operations.

classes.name: WrappedDecoder
classes.description: A wrapper around C2Component that manages filter components and delegates media processing tasks, enabling filtering and component chaining.

classes.name: PassingListener
classes.description: Listener implementation that forwards work completion and error events, managing work item state and error reporting.

classes.name: LastListener
classes.description: Listener implementation that forwards events to the wrapped listener, used for the last component in the chain.

methods.name: takeFilters
methods.description: Transfers filter components to the interface, querying supported parameters and configuring filters accordingly.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the component interface.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the component interface.

methods.name: query_vb
methods.description: Queries parameters from the component, filtering based on internal mappings.

methods.name: config_vb
methods.description: Configures parameters on the component, propagating to filter components.

methods.name: transferParams_l
methods.description: Transfers parameters between components, flipping parameter directions for chaining.

methods.name: backPropagateParams_l
methods.description: Propagates parameters backward in the component chain, querying and configuring parameters.

methods.name: setListener_vb
methods.description: Sets event listener for the component, wrapping with forwarding listeners.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the component and its filters, skipping disabled filters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the component and its filters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the component and filters, clearing state.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the component and filters, cleaning up resources.
